speaker: Captain Hask
description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.9): the toll-riders' toll (quest.kingsroad_toll). Pay 1 iron (world.toll_fort.paid) or, at stage 4, cow him (world.toll_fort.cowed): the fort's garrison then stands down for good. Refusing (world.toll_fort.defied) ends its stand-down: the fort fights. Breaching the gate needs no words.

nodes.text: Halt! The King's Road is the toll-riders' road, by Aldmere's charter. One iron for passage - or try the fort's pikes.

choices.locked_text: You have no iron to pay with

choices.text: [Loom over him] You will let me pass. For nothing.
choices.locked_text: Return when you stand at stage 4

nodes.text: Paid in full. The King's Road is yours, giant - the fort will not trouble you.
P-pass! Pass, and go in peace. Nobody asked for any toll.
Then you'll pay in blood. To arms!
You broke our gate, you brute! There is no toll to take from a thing like you.
